title: RAS Polity Chapter 2: Rajasthan High Court, RPSC, SHRC & Lokayukta
summary: Comprehensive legal and constitutional guide on the Rajasthan High Court (Jodhpur/Jaipur Bench), RPSC (Satyanarayan Rao Committee), SHRC, and Lokayukta Act 1973...

blocks.content:
### ⚖️ Rajasthan Judicial Setup & Apex State Commissions

1. **Rajasthan High Court (Article 214):**
   • **Inauguration:** Inaugurated by Rajpramukh Maharaja Sawai Man Singh on **29 August 1949** at Jodhpur.
   • **First Chief Justice:** **Justice Kamala Kant Verma** (sworn in with 11 judges).
   • **Permanent Principal Seat & Bench:** Principal seat established at **Jodhpur**; Permanent Bench established at **Jaipur** on **31 January 1977** (under President's order based on Satyanarayan Rao Committee recommendation).
   • **Sanctioned Judge Strength:** **50 Judges** (38 Permanent + 12 Additional).
2. **Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC - Article 315):**
   • **Establishment:** Constituted on **20 August 1949** at Jaipur (later shifted to **Ajmer in 1956** on Satyanarayan Rao Committee recommendation).
   • **First Chairman:** **Sir S.K. Ghosh** (Chief Justice of Rajasthan High Court held additional charge).
   • **Composition:** 1 Chairman + **7 Members** (Total 8, appointed by Governor under Article 316; removal by President of India under Article 317).
   • **Tenure:** **6 years or 62 years of age** (whichever is earlier).
3. **Rajasthan State Human Rights Commission (SHRC):**
   • **Notification:** Notified on **18 January 1999**; became functional on **23 March 2000** under Human Rights Protection Act, 1993.
   • **First Chairperson:** **Justice Kanta Bhatnagar**.
   • **Composition (2019 Amendment):** 1 Chairperson (former High Court Chief Justice or Judge) + **2 Members**.
   • **Tenure:** **3 years or 70 years of age** (eligible for re-appointment).
4. **Rajasthan Lokayukta and Up-Lokayuktas Act, 1973:**
   • **Assent & Enactment:** Passed in 1973; received Presidential assent on **26 March 1973**; effective from **3 February 1973**.
   • **First Lokayukta:** **Justice I.D. Dua** (appointed 28 Aug 1973); First Up-Lokayukta: K.P.U. Menon.
   • **Jurisdiction Exclusions:** Chief Minister, Members of RPSC, High Court Judges, and Chief Election Officer are strictly **OUTSIDE Lokayukta jurisdiction**!

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — RPSC RAS Top Traps:
1. **Lokayukta Exclusion:** Chief Minister is strictly **EXCLUDED** from the Lokayukta's jurisdiction in Rajasthan (unlike Karnataka where CM is included).
2. **RPSC Removal:** RPSC Chairman/Members are *appointed* by the **Governor**, but can be *removed* ONLY by the **President of India** (Article 317) on grounds of misbehavior after Supreme Court inquiry!
